name: Manage Agents
description: List MyAgent agents, or create/update one. action='list' returns every agent (id, name, tools); action='save' creates a new agent or updates an existing one — only the fields you pass are changed, the others keep their value.

action.description: 'list' returns all agents; 'save' creates or updates one.

name.description: Display name. Required for 'save'; the id is derived from it unless 'id' is given.

tools.description: Tool folder names the agent may use (e.g. 'web_search', 'file_write'). An unknown name comes back with the valid list.

id.description: Explicit agent id; if it matches an existing agent that agent is updated. Default: slugified name.

copy_from.description: Id of an existing agent to clone as the starting point; fields you also pass override the copy. Ignored when updating.

model_id.description: Model id. Default 'default' (the globally configured model).

enabled.description: Whether the agent is enabled (default true).

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for tool-calling decisions; lower = more deterministic.

response_temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the final answer; lower = less made-up content.

max_tool_calls.description: Max total tool executions per turn (default 5).

memory_enabled.description: Give the agent persistent deep memory across chats (default false). When true, old conversation turns are archived and summarized automatically.

memory_threshold.description: Conversation size (estimated tokens) above which the oldest turns are archived to deep memory (default 4000).

live.description: Start/stop the agent as an autonomous agent (default false). A live agent runs its scheduled tasks on its own and restarts by itself after a server reboot. With no task scheduled it stays idle, so live alone does nothing.

autonomous.description: Optional autonomy safety rails: {max_wakes_per_hour, max_consecutive_errors, wake_timeout_s, notify_binding_id, notify_chat_id, history_messages}. null = defaults. WHEN the agent runs is not set here: that is its task list (manage_tasks / the Tasks page).
